stories.title: Judge dismisses charges against two ex-FBI officials in Hunter Biden probe case
new_facts: Case dismissed against ex-FBI officials Nicole Floris and Bradley Benavides, accused of falsely suggesting to Congress they were unaware of Hunter Biden probes.
Magistrate Judge Zia Faruqui dismissed the case for failure to establish probable cause.
Faruqui called it a rushed, political prosecution ordered by the White House to affect the midterms.
Faruqui reportedly called the case "weaponization" and the government's arguments "slapdash"; Floris ran the Washington Field Office intelligence division.
At a dramatic hearing Faruqui scolded prosecutors; an FBI agent testified he feared the probe would be seen as "political."
Faruqui accused Trump and FBI Director Kash Patel of directing a rush job.
stories.line: A federal judge dismissed charges against two former FBI officials accused of lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden probe.

stories.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in all-stock deal valued near $115 billion
new_facts: Marvell plans to acquire Lumentum for $115B, one of tech's largest deals; Nvidia is strategic investor in both.
Deal expected to close in first half of 2028; Lumentum CEO calls the opportunity 'enormous'.
stories.line: Marvell agreed to buy optical chipmaker Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at about $115 billion including debt, expected to close in 2028.

stories.title: Newborn survival improves when families receive financial support
Hackers hit supermarket fridges and freezers across seven European countries
new_facts: Dozens of supermarkets in Sweden and Belgium hit; freezer temperatures rose overnight; UK retailers warned to patch vulnerabilities.
Attack spans seven European countries; freezer temperatures reportedly rose as high as 50C.
Seven countries named (BE, EE, IE, FI, LU, NL, SE); earlier French attack caused millions of euros of damage.
Earlier October French attack hit hundreds of supermarkets, causing food loss and fires; new spikes reported early Monday.
stories.line: Cyberattacks have disabled supermarket freezers and fridges in seven European countries, spoiling stock, and officials warn UK retailers to patch vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Russell Brand's rape trial: defense says Channel 4 documentary poisoned the well
new_facts: Russell Brand is on trial for rape at Southwark Crown Court; the Daily Mail is covering it with a Trial podcast.
Defence told jurors a Channel 4 documentary and journalists 'poisoned the well'; Brand had much sex, none unlawful.
Defence barrister named as Ian Winter KC; he cited 'monstrous delays' in complainants going to police and denied Brand is a 'psychopath'.
stories.line: Russell Brand is on trial for rape at Southwark Crown Court, with his defense arguing that a Channel 4 documentary and reporting poisoned the case against him.

stories.title: Hackers push fake nuclear warnings through Ukrainian and Russian emergency alert apps
new_facts: Ukrainian and Russian emergency alert apps were hacked hours apart, sending civilians false chemical and nuclear attack warnings.
Russian spies accuse Ukraine of booby-trapping goggles meant for Russian frontline drone pilots (separate story from the alert hacks).
Russian Emergency Situations Ministry's app was breached; Moscow says efforts are under way to restore it.
Attacks happened Sunday evening; neither government has confirmed who was responsible.
stories.line: Hackers sent fake nuclear and air-attack warnings through Ukrainian and Russian emergency alert apps, and both governments report the cyberattacks.

stories.title: Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan Senate race, angering Democrats
new_facts: El-Sayed raised $2.4m Sunday after Stevens endorsed Rogers; final NYT/Siena poll has El-Sayed up 11 points.
Senate stakes: Democrats hold 47 seats, need 51; Peters retiring; Vance breaks a 50-50 tie.
Stevens's fiancé Jason Turkish announced he would vote for Rogers, citing El-Sayed's Israel criticism; allies worried by his behavior.
Dingell and Ocasio-Cortez lobbied Stevens; AOC spoke with her for 25 minutes the day Turkish announced.
Schumer, Jeffries, Mamdani and Hasan Piker publicly condemned Stevens's endorsement switch.
At a Sunday Detroit event with Rogers, Stevens said 'nothing is perfect' and left after a protester called her a traitor.
Stevens and El-Sayed had feuded publicly over a campaign ad Stevens called anti-Semitic.
stories.line: Democrat Haley Stevens endorsed Republican Mike Rogers over fellow Democrat Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's Senate race, drawing party backlash.

stories.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to stop California counting 20,000 mail ballots
new_facts: Trump administration filed emergency Supreme Court application asking it to order California to set aside 20,000 mail-in ballots.
DOJ is also appealing dismissal of a lawsuit over Alaska's Senate election.
Lower courts had already rejected the request to set aside ballots of people the government calls "likely" noncitizens; election is Nov. 3.
stories.line: The Justice Department asks the Supreme Court to block California from counting about 20,000 disputed mail ballots.

stories.title: Iran and US in intensive talks to avert new war; Iran says talks could resume soon
new_facts: Iran says it is in 'intensive' indirect talks with the US to avert new strikes, and would reopen Hormuz if its demands are met.
Qatar is facilitating the indirect talks, which are based on Iran's seven-step peace plan and could resume shortly if demands are met.
stories.line: Iran and the US are negotiating to avert renewed war, with talks possibly resuming soon if Iran's demands are met.

stories.title: Trump and Vance rally before midterms as Talarico draws attacks
new_facts: Trump, Vance and candidates held final rallies on the last day before the US midterms; polls show a tight congressional race.
John Oliver called MAGA smears of Talarico 'middle school level homophobia'; Paxton urged a sparse Texas rally crowd to stay.
Talarico praised Frederick Haynes III at a Texas rally; Haynes called ICE the 'new KKK' and urged abolishing it.
stories.line: Trump, Vance and candidates made final campaign pushes before the US midterms, with attacks on Texas Senate candidate James Talarico drawing focus.
